name: Mixx-DJ-MCP
description: Control Mixxx open-source DJ software through natural language. Search your library, cue tracks, set loops, apply effects, and mix — all from your AI assistant.
author: sandraschi

tools.name: mixx_deck
tools.description: Full deck control: play, stop, cue, loop, sync, hot cues, scratch, seek, beatjump, beatloop, rate, pregain, filter high/mid/low, quantize, keylock, load track, eject

tools.name: mixx_library
tools.description: Library search, crate/playlist browse, track info, filter by BPM/genre/key

tools.name: mixx_effects
tools.description: Effect chain management, enable/disable effects, parameter control, quick effect presets

tools.name: mixx_mixer
tools.description: Crossfader, per-channel EQ (high/mid/low), gain, volume, headphone cue, talkover, orientation, balance

tools.name: mixx_stems
tools.description: Stem separation via Demucs, sampler loading, stem-aware mixing, mute/volume control

tools.name: mixx_transition
tools.description: AI-powered transitions between decks: suggest, apply (echo/filter/hard-cut/spin-back/flanger/reverb/blend), auto-crossfader

tools.name: mixx_vinyl
tools.description: Vinyl control calibration, scratch mode, deck mode switching

tools.name: mixx_crate
tools.description: LLM-generated smart crates based on BPM, key, genre and energy analysis

tools.name: mixx_skin
tools.description: Skin management: list, apply, preview Mixxx skins

tools.name: mixx_controller
tools.description: USB controller auto-detection and mapping management

tools.name: mixx_daw
tools.description: DAW export: render stems, mixdown, cue points to Ableton/Reaper format

tools.name: mixx_set
tools.description: AI set sequencer: plan BPM progression, energy curve, genre flow for a mix set

tools.name: show_deck_status_card
tools.description: Prefab UI card showing live deck status (play state, BPM, key, gain, volume, sync, loop)

tools.name: show_mixer_status_card
tools.description: Prefab UI card showing mixer state (crossfader, per-deck levels)

tools.name: show_library_status_card
tools.description: Prefab UI card showing library connection and search status
